item.title: In the new animated film 'Forgotten Island,' Filipino mythology is the main character
item.description: Filipino mythology takes the stage in the new film 'Forgotten Island.' NPR's Debbie Elliott speaks to actress Lea Salonga, who voices the Manananggal.

item.title: PHOTOS: The precarious life of fisherfolk
item.description: In the bustling heart of the southern Indian city of Chennai is a market that never sleeps, where residents from the poorest neighborhoods wage a battle of survival with the sea.

item.title: America 250: Unraveling the secret inscriptions inside Lincoln's watch
item.description: When President Lincoln's pocket watch was being cleaned in 1861, the watchmaker inscribed a secret message about a pivotal moment in the nation's history that still resonates today.

item.title: Archaeologists are racing to save precious artifacts in Alaska after last year's storm
item.description: Last year, remnants of a typhoon damaged homes, infrastructure and an archaeological dig site. Now, archaeologists are trying to get as many objects out as possible before the next storm.
